text: Describe your career journey and the defining moments that shaped you.
Tell us about the toughest technical or operational challenge you handled: the situation, what you did and the result.
What is one mistake or failure that taught you the most? What would you do differently?
What safety, HSE or risk lessons from your experience must every new employee know?
What rules of thumb or tacit knowledge do you use that are not written in any manual?
Who mentored you, and how did you pass on knowledge to your juniors?
What unfinished work, risks or opportunities are you handing over to your successor?
What advice would you give to young colleagues joining your function today?
